private_leagues_intro: Follow your group's strategies, compare results, and see how each person invests.
private_leagues_create_needs_pro: Joining with a code is free. Creating a league is for Pro or for anyone with a league pass.
private_leagues_empty_title: You aren't in a league yet
private_leagues_empty_text: Join with the code from whoever runs the league, or create your own with Pro or a league pass.
private_leagues_invited_text: Enter the organizer's code. Your strategy will appear once it has a portfolio.
private_leagues_members_see: League members see the name, crest and results of your representative strategy, never its portfolio or recipe.
private_leagues_create_group_text: Create a league and share its code. Each person participates with their own account, free ones included.
private_leagues_no_round_context: No round has formed yet. The group's progress will appear here.
private_leagues_standings_context: Ranked by official season points, then by cumulative difference versus the S&P in a tie.
private_leagues_rep_strategy_answer: The highest-ranked strategy for the season. If it has no points yet, the oldest strategy with a portfolio formed this season is used. You don't need to sign it up for this league again.
private_leagues_cumulative_note: Cumulative results cover each strategy's own period, which may differ. Sharing a league doesn't grant access to private methodologies.
private_leagues_market_checked: Market checked at {time}. Quotes may be delayed.
private_leagues_join_create_note: Create a strategy and sign it up for the next round to start comparing.
private_leagues_member_create_note: Their results will appear here once their first portfolio forms.
private_leagues_share_code_note: Share this code. Any account can use it in Private Leagues, free ones included.
private_leagues_copy_manually: Select the code and copy it manually.
private_leagues_change_code_note: The old code will stop working. Current members will stay in the league.
private_leagues_compare_note: This month is ranked by return. Standings keeps official points. Risk metrics need enough history.
private_leagues_remove_body: They will leave “{name}”. With the current invite code they could join again: if you don't want that, generate a new one afterwards.
private_leagues_leave_body: You will no longer be in its standings. To come back you will need an invite code.
